2026-04-21

Source: vignettes/references.Rmd
references.Rmd

This page consolidates the primary literature underlying every numerical and analytical component of janos. References are grouped by capability and numbered for cross-linking from the vignettes and from the README.

Deterministic integration

[DP5] Dormand, J. R. and Prince, P. J. (1980). A family of embedded Runge-Kutta formulae. Journal of Computational and Applied Mathematics, 6(1), 19-26. doi:10.1016/0771-050X(80)90013-3

[Rodas3] Hairer, E. and Wanner, G. (1996). Solving Ordinary Differential Equations II: Stiff and Differential-Algebraic Problems. Springer Series in Computational Mathematics 14, Springer. ISBN 978-3-642-05221-7

[MOL] Schiesser, W. E. (1991). The Numerical Method of Lines: Integration of Partial Differential Equations. Academic Press. ISBN 978-0126241303
